why: replace the scaffold placeholders in multichannel-critter-sensor's overview and the domains and standards indexes with its real content

ops.body: Multichannel Critter Sensor is an Oxygen Not Included mod that adds a room-based critter and egg counter for the Automation Ribbon. It counts critters and eggs in its room like the vanilla Critter Sensor, lets the player choose which species and egg types to count, and writes a 4-bit value to its ribbon output port, with combined or separate critter/egg thresholds and rising/falling count pulses. The building has its own kanim art by 3GuB, used with permission, and a side screen built from PLib UI plus clones of the vanilla threshold editors. Version 0.3.0 is released on the Steam Workshop (id 3804039425); `mod.yaml` sets `supportedContent: ALL` and `minimumSupportedBuild: 744825`. The mod is available in English, Chinese (Simplified), Korean and Russian.

- `src/MultichannelCritterSensor/`: the mod. `Mod.cs` (entry point), `MultichannelCritterSensorConfig.cs` (building definition), `MultichannelCritterSensor.cs` (the counting component), `MultichannelCritterSensorSideScreen.cs` (the side screen), `ThresholdAdapter.cs` (exposes a threshold to the cloned vanilla editor), `Patches.cs` (build menu, research and details-screen patches), `ModStrings.cs`, `mod.yaml`, `mod_info.yaml`.
- `src/MultichannelCritterSensor/anim/` and `anim-original/`: the sensor's kanim art and the original art it came from; `translations/` holds the `.pot` template and `.po` files.
- `src/MultichannelCritterSensor.Tests/`: in-game tests (`Config.cs`, `Counting.cs`, `SideScreen.cs`, shared `Kit.cs`).
- `publish/`: Workshop material (`workshop-description.txt`, `workshop-id.txt`, `logo.jpg`, `preview.gif`).
- `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`: user-facing description and release history.
- `.context/` holds `overview.md` (this file), `domains/` (entities and glossary), `standards/` (code style, error handling, naming conventions), `decisions/`, `retrospectives/`, `projects.md` and `META.md`.

- [entities](entities.md): what the mod adds (the sensor building, its component, side screen and threshold adapter), with file locations, the counting and output rules and key code paths.
- [glossary](glossary.md): ONI and mod-specific terms used by Multichannel Critter Sensor.

- [code-style](code-style.md): C# formatting, imports, comments, Harmony patch and component conventions, with this mod's own layout.
- [error-handling](error-handling.md): how Multichannel Critter Sensor guards its Harmony patches, reflection lookups and file reads, and what it logs when something is missing.
- [naming-conventions](naming-conventions.md): file, namespace, patch class, string key and id naming for project MultichannelCritterSensor.
